auditMethod: Live indexed English Wowhead excerpts; direct HTML returned JavaScript verification; no browser Translator API replay
issueClass: indexed guide widget key=value configuration contaminates offline language evidence
evidence: stat-guide=<number> and stats=<priority expression> appear in multiple independent overview cheat sheets (Devourer, Outlaw Rogue, Protection Paladin, Arms Warrior).
fixLayer: offline audit language evidence only; generic key=value token filter; no brittle class selectors, Data Pack changes, or browser code
sourceIssuesNotMezuErrors: Some indexed pages omit dynamic spell/expansion placeholders or duplicate cheat-sheet text; these cannot be attributed to MEZU translation.
caveats: The source-only filter removes assignment-like widget tokens from language evidence; it does not remove them from rendered guide content.
The new tests use short source fragments and synthetic prose, not full copyrighted guides.
